en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-190 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said,

“I can foresee the palaces set up besides the shrine of Al-Husayn (a.s.). It is as if many carriages have set out from Kufa towards the shrine of Al-Husayn (a.s.). Not before a few days and nights have passed will they set out towards him, and this is at the end of the era of the Umayyads.”
